studies.sourceHypothesisText: STEP is a Randomized, Multifactorial, Adaptive Platform trial that seeks to optimize the care of patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) due to large or medium vessel occlusions (LVOs and MVOs). The currently open domain looks to expand indication for EVT.
sourceGaps: First-pass ClinicalTrials.gov summary: not all registry criteria, protocol details, local activation requirements, or consent rules are encoded in this screening summary.
CT.gov requires presentation to the enrolling hospital within 24 hours and arterial puncture within 2 hours of qualifying imaging; this screening summary does not encode every STEP domain exclusion.

studies.conciseBedsideSummary: Optimizes endovascular therapy for low NIHSS LVOs or non-dominant MVOs. Excludes dominant M2 branch.
studies.pathway: Consult Stroke Research Coordinator / On-Call Stroke Fellow or Endovascular Coordinator
exactInclusionCriteria: Age 18 years or older and pre-stroke mRS 0-2
Presentation to enrolling hospital within 24 hours and arterial puncture within 2 hours of qualifying imaging
Branch 1: LVO patients with mild deficits/low NIHSS; NIHSS 0-5 and complete occlusion of the intracranial ICA or M1 MCA
Branch 2: MVO/DMVO patients with non-dominant/co-dominant M2 or M3 occlusions; NIHSS ≥ 8
MVO beyond 6 hours: infarct core <50% of the occluded vessel territory; confirm on protocol-specified imaging
exactExclusionCriteria: CT ASPECTS <6 or MRI ASPECTS <7
Acute occlusions in multiple vascular territories
Tandem occlusions
